item_title: Successor Agency Audited Financial Statements for Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2025
document_text:
9.1 Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of San Jose - Audited Financial Statements for Fiscal Year ended June 30, 2025.
Accept the Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Independent Auditor's Reports and Basic Financial Statements for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of San Jose.

Maria Oberg, Director, Finance Department; Victor Lo, Deputy Director, Finance Department; and Ben Lau, CPA, Partner: Macias, Gina & O'Connell, offered the presentation and responded to questions from Council.

Public Comment: Brian Darby offered public comment.

Action: Upon motion by Councilmember Anthony Tordillos, seconded by Councilmember Bien Doan, and carried unanimously, the Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Independent Auditor's Reports and Basic Financial Statements for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of San Jose were accepted. (11-0-0)
